verdict.rationale: AngelList is a SaaS platform, so offering official SDKs is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions an SDK, client library, or public API. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt help index, the HRIS integrations and the OCF cap-table export are adjacent features, not SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
